title: Ridgeline Special Order Services Store Pickup Standard: Release, Linked-Item Storage and Abandonment
content:
These provisions govern a Ridgeline Special Order Services item once it is ready at the store.

*Retired clause.* The following clause is **no longer in force**: "A ready item is held free for the program's free hold days after the ready date; after that, where the storage fee per day is above 0.00, storage is charged per day for the storage days — the calendar days from the day after the ready date plus the free hold to the earlier of the pickup or delivery date and today, excluding the days an item linked to an installation contract is held for its installation date where free storage for linked items applies — never more than the storage cap in total, as a storage fee billed when the item leaves the store." It has been superseded by the current storage charge basis.

**1. Linked items.** An item linked to a Ridgeline Installation Services contract is stored free until its installation date where the program provides free storage for linked items.

**2. Release.** The item is released only when the order's balance due, including storage, is 0.00.

**3. Abandonment.** An item neither picked up nor delivered when the program's abandonment period, in days after the ready date, has run is treated as abandoned: the order is cancelled with the cancellation reason abandoned, and an abandonment fee of the program's abandonment fee percentage of the order total is charged; the payments less the fee and any storage are refunded.

## Release check

| Balance due on the order, storage included | Item released |
|---|---|
| 0.00 | yes |
| any amount above 0.00 | no |

## Abandonment settlement (hypothetical Windows and Exterior Doors order: abandonment period 60 days, fee 25 percent)

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Order total | 1200.00 |
| Payments received | 1200.00 |
| Abandonment fee, 25 percent of 1200.00 | 300.00 |
| Storage charged on the order (hypothetical) | 40.00 |
| Refunded: payments less the fee and the storage | 860.00 |

For an item that became ready on 10 January (hypothetical), a 60-day abandonment period runs to 11 March in a year that is not a leap year.

superseded_clauses: A ready item is held free for pickup_hold_days days after ready_date; after that, where storage_fee_per_day_usd is above 0.00, storage is charged per day for special_msr_storage_days, never more than storage_fee_cap_usd in total, as fee_type storage_fee billed when the item leaves the store.
